evidence.note: The bank's estimate totals $302 billion within the cumulative period. It supports the debt component, though hyperscaler debt is not necessarily all earmarked for AI.
The bank estimates nearly $500 billion of AI-related issuance before the post. This supports the debt component, not the other clauses.
This company disclosure establishes revenue concentration. It does not establish that most GPU units reach a few ultimate buyers or measure their use.

reviews.rationale: The debt component has support. The packet does not establish whether most GPUs bought by the large buyers were unused in September. Broad electronics price increases and market dependence also remain unmeasured. Partial support without a settled contrary component does not establish a mixed result.
